name: Umi to Onsen to Natsuyasumi
source:
Two familes go on a sea hot spring trip.
Adults are absent drinking and children can play freely.
You can play with the beautiful sisters in the sea and the mixed hot spring.
A week of an exciting summer vacation starts.
